answers.5:
Field Data - This is the data metrics calculated in the real world use-cases.
Lab Data - This is a the data metrics calculated in a controlled environment, usually mimicking worst case scenario.

Both are use as Lab Data can be used to gate the releases. While Field data can be used to plan and fix performance issues. Lab Data can be for of an engineering driven task, while field data can be used to rope in product team and work togeather

LCP depends on alot of aspects.
TTFB
FCP
TBT
CLS
and others
TTFB can be improved by improving the network layer, caching static content in edge servers, compressing the payload using gzip or brotli
FCP can be improved by removing render blocking scripts/fonts.
CLS can be improved by setting image height and width, use skeletal loaders
